page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is configured with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per physical core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density make it a specialized resource for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity without the overhead of hyperthreading, as it operates with a single thread per core.

The ecs.r7.16xlarge is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. Suitable applications include large-scale in-memory databases, high-performance caching layers, data analytics pipelines, and enterprise-grade applications that demand significant memory footprints and dedicated compute resources.
